description: How do BeginTrans, CommitTrans and Rollback answer extra arguments, and does an answered call still change the level? Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid), opened writable through DBEngine.OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0). Workspaces(0).BeginTrans(4-byte 1); DBEngine.Errors; UPDATE Lv SET V = 1 WHERE ID = 1 (dbFailOnError); CommitTrans(4-byte 0, 4-byte 0); DBEngine.Errors; Rollback(4-byte 1); DBEngine.Errors; read the Lv sum; Rollback with no arguments; DBEngine.Errors; read the Lv sum; close; read the Lv sum through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
